defaultDownloadQuality.title: 默认下载音质 / Default download quality
defaultDownloadQuality.description: Preselected quality in the download pickers. 'auto' follows the playback quality selector; the last quality picked in a download menu is remembered on top of this.

musicFolder.title: 音乐文件夹覆盖 / Music folder override
musicFolder.description: Base folder for right-click downloads. Empty = system Music folder. Tracks are saved under <folder>/Stream.

autoRefreshDailyPlaylists.title: 自动刷新每日推荐歌单 / Auto-refresh daily playlists
autoRefreshDailyPlaylists.description: Scan and refresh NetEase daily songs, daily playlists, and radar lists at 06:05 Beijing time and after launch if today's set is stale.

autoSyncDailyPlaylists.title: 自动同步新出现的每日歌单 / Auto-sync new daily playlists
autoSyncDailyPlaylists.description: When auto-refresh runs, also import newly appeared daily playlists into the local Playlists page. Off keeps refresh limited to lists already synced.

autoUnblock.title: 网易云歌曲解灰 / Unblock grey NetEase tracks
autoUnblock.description: When a NetEase track is greyed out or official resolve fails, fall back to the enhanced API match sources.

similarAutoPlay.title: 相似歌曲自动播放 / Auto-play similar tracks
similarAutoPlay.description: Queue similar NetEase tracks and, after the batch finishes, recommend again from the last played song.

similarCount.title: 每次推荐首数 / Similar batch size
